title: How to organize the family hook zone | Mudroom
description:
Holds the coats and bags that leave in the morning and come back the same evening.

This is the Family Hook Zone in the Mudroom. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Two coats and one bag per person, each on their own named column, the lowest hooks set at the height of the shortest person in the house, and bare floor along the whole run of wall beneath them.

Shine: Wipe the rail and the wall behind it where shoulders and sleeves leave a grey smear, then vacuum the narrow st
Safety: A hook carrying four wet coats will pull a screw straight out of plasterboard, so check that every hook sits i
Standardize: Write each name on its column at that person's eye height, and say the limit out loud so everyone hears it: on
Sustain: When you hang your own coat up at the end of the day, look along the wall and move anything sitting on the wro

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One coat, one bag, one hat per named column, and the floor under the hooks stays empty.
